item.title: Helping Southeast Asian Cities Improve Air Quality with Data
item.description: Traffic congestion is not only a mobility challenge. In many cities, it is also a public health challenge. An Asian Development Bank (ADB) project leverages data from GrabMaps, Quadrant, and VesselBot to model traffic and emissions in Southeast Asian cities, with the aim of helping policymakers better understand the impact of their transport policies.
